procedures.doc: Returns the value of global SkipTaxCalculation flag.

procedures.name: SetSkipTaxCalulation
procedures.doc: Sets the global flag SkipTaxCalculation value.

procedures.name: SetHideValidationDialog
procedures.doc: Sets the global HideValidationDialog flag.

procedures.name: GetHideValidationDialog
procedures.doc: Gets the global HideValidationDialog flag.

procedures.name: GetCaptionClass
procedures.doc: Gets a caption class for a field.

procedures.name: TestStatusOpen

procedures.name: GetSuspendedStatusCheck
procedures.doc: Returns the value of the global variable StatusCheckSuspended.

procedures.name: SuspendStatusCheck
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the global variable StatusCheckSuspended.

procedures.name: UpdateVATOnLines
procedures.doc: Updates VAT and related amounts on all lines of the document.

procedures.doc: Calculates the VAT amounts for purchase lines based on the quantity type, and updates the VAT amount lines accordingly.

procedures.name: UpdateWithWarehouseReceive
procedures.doc: Updates the quantities to receive or return for a purchase line based on the document type, quantity, and the location.

procedures.name: CheckWarehouse
procedures.doc: Checks warehouse requirements for a purchase line.

procedures.name: GetOverheadRateFCY
procedures.doc: Calculates the overhead rate in foreign currency for the purchase line.

procedures.name: GetItemTranslation

procedures.name: AdjustDateFormula
procedures.doc: Formats a date formula parameter and returns it as a text.

procedures.name: RowID1

procedures.name: JobSetCurrencyFactor
procedures.doc: Updates the job currency factor from the temporary global job journal line.

procedures.name: SetUpdateFromVAT
procedures.doc: Sets the value of the global variable UpdateFromVAT.

procedures.doc: Retrieves a record set of item purchase lines that match the provided document type and various filters set on the item.

procedures.doc: Determines if any purchase lines exist that match the provided document type and various flow filters set on the item.

procedures.doc: Determines if the line is an inventoriable item line.

procedures.name: EmptyLine
procedures.doc: Determines if the general journal line is empty. It is considered empty if account number, amount, and balance account number (if not system created entry) are blank.

procedures.name: EmptyLine
procedures.doc: Determines if the current item journal line is considered empty based on its quantity, time, item number, and value entry type.

procedures.name: IsValueEntryForDeletedItem
procedures.doc: Determines if the current item journal line is for a deleted item based on its entry type, value entry type, item number, item charge number, and invoiced quantity.

procedures.name: UpdateAmount
procedures.doc: Updates the amount of the current item journal line to reflect changes in quantity and unit amount.

procedures.name: CheckItemAvailable
procedures.doc: Checks if the item is available based on the current item journal line.

procedures.name: SetUpNewLine
procedures.doc: Initializes a new item journal line based on the previous item journal line record.

procedures.name: SetDocNos
procedures.doc: Sets the document-related fields of an item journal line.

procedures.name: GetUnitAmount
procedures.doc: Updates the unit amount of the current item journal line.

procedures.name: ApplyPrice
procedures.doc: Updates the price of the item journal line.

procedures.name: GetLineWithPrice
procedures.doc: Gets the default or overridden line with price interface implementation.

procedures.name: Signed
procedures.doc: Adjusts the sign of the provided value based on the document type of the item journal line.

procedures.name: IsInbound
procedures.doc: Determines if the item journal line is inbound based on the quantities.

procedures.name: OpenItemTrackingLines
procedures.doc: Opens a page for editing item tracking lines for the item journal line.

procedures.name: CreateDim
procedures.doc: Creates dimensions for the item journal line based on the provided default dimension sources.

procedures.name: CreateDim
procedures.doc: Creates dimensions for the item journal line based on the provided default dimension sources, an inherited dimension set ID and an inherited table number.

procedures.name: CopyDim
procedures.doc: Sets dimensions to the item journal line from the provided dimension set.

procedures.name: ValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Verifies whether the provided shortcut dimension code and value are valid.

procedures.name: LookupShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Opens a page for selecting a dimension code, then assigns the selected value to the provided number of the shortcut dimension.

procedures.name: ShowShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Gets an array of shortcut dimension values from the dimensions of the item journal line.

procedures.name: ValidateNewShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Verifies whether the provided new shortcut dimension code and value are valid.

procedures.name: LookupNewShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Opens a page for selecting a dimension code, then assigns the selected value to the presented number of the new shortcut dimension.

procedures.name: ShowNewShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Gets an array of new shortcut dimension values from the dimensions of the item journal line.

procedures.name: CopyDocumentFields
procedures.doc: Copies provided document-related fields to the current item journal line record.

procedures.name: CopyFromSalesHeader
procedures.doc: Copies fields from the provided sales header record to the current item journal line.

procedures.name: CopyFromSalesLine
procedures.doc: Copies fields from the provided sales line record to the current item journal line.

procedures.name: CopyFromPurchHeader
procedures.doc: Copies fields from the provided purchase header record to the current item journal line.

procedures.name: CopyFromPurchLine
procedures.doc: Copies fields from the provided purchase line record to the current item journal line.

procedures.name: CopyFromJobJnlLine
procedures.doc: Copies fields from the provided job journal line record to the current item journal line.

procedures.name: RetrieveCosts
procedures.doc: Retrieves and sets the global UnitCost variable for an item journal line.

procedures.name: TimeIsEmpty
procedures.doc: Determines if time related fields of the current item journal line record are empty.

procedures.name: OnlyStopTime
procedures.doc: Determines if only the stop time field of the current item journal line record is set.

procedures.name: RowID1
procedures.doc: Generates a unique identifier text for a item journal line record which is used for item tracking.

procedures.name: GetSourceCaption
procedures.doc: Returns a formatted text that represents the source of an item journal line record.

procedures.name: SetReservationEntry
procedures.doc: Initializes the reservation entries from the item journal line.

procedures.name: SetReservationFilters
procedures.doc: Filters reservation entry from the item journal line.

procedures.name: ReservEntryExist
procedures.doc: Checks if reservation entry exists for the item journal line.

procedures.name: LookupItemNo
procedures.doc: Performs a lookup for the item of an item journal line based on its entry type.

procedures.name: RecalculateUnitAmount
procedures.doc: Updates the unit amount for an item journal line record based on various factors such as the item's indirect cost percentage, overhead rate, quantity per unit of measure, and entry type.

procedures.name: IsReclass
procedures.doc: Determines whether an item journal line represents a reclassification.

procedures.name: ShowDimensions
procedures.doc: Opens a page for editing dimensions for the item journal line.

procedures.name: ShowReclasDimensions
procedures.doc: Opens a page for editing the dimension set associated with a reclassification in the current item journal line.

procedures.name: SwitchLinesWithErrorsFilter
procedures.doc: Toggles the visibility of item journal lines based on whether they have associated error messages.

procedures.name: ClearTracking
procedures.doc: Clears the tracking information (serial, lot and package number) of an item journal line.

procedures.name: ClearDates
procedures.doc: Clears the expiration and warranty dates of the item journal line.

procedures.name: CopyTrackingFromReservEntry
procedures.doc: Copies tracking information (serial, lot and package number) from a reservation entry to an item journal line.

procedures.name: CopyTrackingFromItemLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Copies tracking information (serial, lot and package number) from a item ledger entry to an item journal line.

procedures.name: CopyTrackingFromSpec
procedures.doc: Copies tracking information (serial, lot and package number) from a tracking specification to an item journal line.

procedures.name: CopyNewTrackingFromNewSpec
procedures.doc: Copies new tracking information (new serial number and new lot number) from a tracking specification to an item journal line.

procedures.name: CopyNewTrackingFromOldItemLedgerEntry
procedures.doc: Copies tracking information (serial, lot and package number) from a item ledger entry to an item journal line.

procedures.name: SetTrackingFilterFromItemLedgerEntry
procedures.doc: Set tracking information (serial, lot and package number) filter from a item ledger entry to an item journal line.

procedures.name: TrackingExists
procedures.doc: Determines whether tracking information exists for an item journal line.

procedures.name: HasSameTracking
procedures.doc: Determines whether the current item journal line has the same tracking information as the provided item journal line.

procedures.name: HasSameNewTracking
procedures.doc: Determines whether the current item journal line has the same serial, lot and package numbers as the new serial, lot and package numbers.

procedures.name: TestItemFields
procedures.doc: Tests if the item number, variant code and location code in an item journal line are the same as the provided values.

procedures.name: DisplayErrorIfItemIsBlocked
procedures.doc: Checks if the provided item is blocked and raises an error message if it is.

procedures.name: DisplayErrorIfItemVariantIsBlocked
procedures.doc: Checks if the provided item variant is blocked and raises an error message if it is.

procedures.name: IsPurchaseReturn
procedures.doc: Determines whether an item journal line represents a purchase return.

procedures.name: IsOpenedFromBatch
procedures.doc: Determines whether the current item journal line record was opened from a batch.

procedures.name: CheckItemJournalLineRestriction
procedures.doc: Triggers the OnCheckItemJournalLinePostRestrictions event to check any additional restrictions before posting item journal line.

procedures.name: CheckTrackingIsEmpty
procedures.doc: Tests if the tracking information (serial, lot and package number) in the item journal line is empty.

procedures.name: CheckNewTrackingIsEmpty
procedures.doc: Tests if the new tracking information (new serial number and new lot number) in the item journal line is empty.

procedures.name: CheckTrackingEqualItemLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Tests if the tracking information (serial, lot and package number) in the item journal line is equal to the tracking information in the provided item ledger entry.

procedures.name: CheckTrackingEqualTrackingSpecification
procedures.doc: Tests if the tracking information (serial, lot and package number) in the item journal line is equal to the tracking information in the provided tracking specifiation.

procedures.name: CheckTrackingIfRequired
procedures.doc: Tests if the tracking information (serial, lot and package number) of the item journal line are filled if required by the item tracking setup.

procedures.name: CheckNewTrackingIfRequired
procedures.doc: Tests if the new tracking information (new serial number and new lot number) of the item journal line are filled if required by the item tracking setup.

procedures.name: CheckTrackingIfRequiredNotBlank
procedures.doc: Tests if the new tracking information (new serial number and new lot number) of the item journal line is required and not empty. If the tracking information is required and empty, an error message is raised.

procedures.name: ValidateTypeWithItemNo
procedures.doc: Tests the type of the item journal line based on the type of the associated item.

procedures.name: IsNotInternalWhseMovement
procedures.doc: Determines if the item journal line does not represent an internal warehouse movement.

procedures.name: PrintInventoryMovement
procedures.doc: Runs the inventory movement report for the item journal lines that have the same journal template name and journal batch name as the current item journal line.

procedures.name: CreateDimFromDefaultDim
procedures.doc: Initializes the dimensions for the item journal line if default dimensions are defined for the related entry.

procedures.name: RenumberDocumentNo
procedures.doc: Renumbers the document number of the current item journal line based on the number series specified in the associated item journal batch.

procedures.name: LookUpTrackingSummary
procedures.doc: Opens the item tracking summary page to update the tracking information for an item journal line based on the specified tracking type.

procedures.name: GetDateForCalculations
procedures.doc: Gets the date required for item journal line calculations.

procedures.name: OnAfterInitDefaultDimensionSources
procedures.doc: Event triggered after initializing default dimension sources for the Item Journal Line record. Subscribing to this event allows developers to extend the standard behavior of initializing default dimesions for the item journal record.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCreateDim
procedures.doc: Event triggerd before creating a dimension for an item journal line. Subscribing to this event allows developers to implement custom logic or override asigning default source dimensions to the item journal line.

procedures.name: OnAfterSetupNewLine
procedures.doc: Event triggered after the new item journal line has been set up. This event allows developers to add custom logic or make adjustments to the record after the new line has been configured.

procedures.name: OnAfterSigned
procedures.doc: Event triggered after calculating the signed value. This event allows developers to adjust or log the signed value after the main procedure logic has executed.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyItemJnlLineFromSalesHeader
procedures.doc: Event triggered after copying data from the "Sales Header" to the current record. This event allows developers to implement custom logic or make adjustments to the current record after data has been copied from the "Sales Header."

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyItemJnlLineFromSalesLine
procedures.doc: Event triggered after copying data from the "Sales Line" to the current record. This event allows developers to implement custom logic or make adjustments to the current record after data has been copied from the "Sales Line."

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyItemJnlLineFromPurchHeader
procedures.doc: Event triggered after copying data from the "Purchase Header" to the current record. This event allows developers to implement custom logic or make adjustments to the current record after data has been copied from the "Purchase Header."

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyItemJnlLineFromPurchLine
procedures.doc: Event triggered after copying data from the "Purchase Line" to the current record. This event allows developers to implement custom logic or make adjustments to the current record after data has been copied from the "Purchase Line."

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyItemJnlLineFromJobJnlLine
procedures.doc: Event triggered after copying data from the "Job Journal Line" to the current record. This event allows developers to implement custom logic or make adjustments to the current record after data has been copied from the "Job Journal Line."

procedures.name: OnAfterGetItemChange
procedures.doc: Event triggered after getting the global "Item" record based on the "Item No." field value. This event allows developers to apply additional logic or handle changes after the global "Item" record has been retrieved.

procedures.name: OnAfterGetItemVariantChange
procedures.doc: Event triggered after getting the global "Item Variant" record and synchronizing it with the "Variant Code" and "Item No." fields. This event allows developers to apply additional logic or handle changes after the "Item Variant" record has been retrieved.

procedures.name: OnAfterGetLineWithPrice

procedures.name: LookUpDimFilter
procedures.doc: Opens dimension value lookup dialog for the specified dimension number and returns selected filter values. Enables interactive dimension value selection for dimension-based filtering in account schedule calculations.

procedures.name: CheckFormula
procedures.doc: Validates formula syntax for proper parentheses matching and operator placement in account schedule formulas. Ensures formulas are syntactically correct before use in financial calculations.

procedures.doc: Opens appropriate lookup dialog based on totaling type for selecting accounts, cost types, or cash flow accounts. Provides user-friendly selection interface for building totaling expressions in account schedule lines.

procedures.name: LookupGLBudgetFilter
procedures.doc: Opens G/L budget name lookup dialog and returns selected budget names as filter text. Enables interactive selection of G/L budgets for budget-based financial analysis.

procedures.doc: Opens cost budget name lookup dialog and returns selected budget names as filter text. Enables interactive selection of cost budgets for cost accounting-based financial analysis.

procedures.name: Outdent
procedures.doc: Decreases indentation level for hierarchical display of account schedule line. Minimum indentation level is 0.

procedures.name: UpdateAllocations
procedures.doc: Updates allocation amounts and distributions for all allocation lines associated with the specified journal line. Recalculates allocation percentages and amounts to ensure total allocation equals journal line amount.

procedures.name: UpdateAllocationsAddCurr
procedures.doc: Updates allocation amounts in additional reporting currency for all allocation lines associated with the specified journal line. Converts allocation amounts to additional currency using current exchange rates.

procedures.name: CheckVAT
procedures.doc: Validates VAT setup and calculations for this allocation line based on the associated journal line context. Ensures VAT posting groups and calculation types are compatible with journal line requirements.

procedures.name: UpdateVAT
procedures.doc: Updates VAT amounts and percentages for this allocation line based on current VAT setup and allocation amount. Calculates VAT amount using VAT posting group configuration and allocation base amount.

procedures.name: GetCurrencyCode
procedures.doc: Retrieves the currency code applicable to this allocation line based on the associated journal line. Returns the journal line's currency code or LCY if no specific currency is defined.

procedures.name: CreateDim
procedures.doc: Creates dimension set for this allocation line from the specified default dimension sources. Builds dimension combinations for financial analysis and reporting requirements.

procedures.name: ValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Validates shortcut dimension code for the specified dimension and updates the allocation line's dimension set. Ensures dimension values are valid and updates the dimension set ID accordingly.

procedures.name: LookupShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Opens lookup for shortcut dimension code selection and updates the allocation line's dimension set. Provides user interface for selecting valid dimension values for the specified dimension.

procedures.name: ShowShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Retrieves and displays shortcut dimension codes for this allocation line in the provided array. Populates shortcut dimension code array with current dimension values for display purposes.

procedures.name: ShowDimensions
procedures.doc: Opens the dimensions page to display and allow editing of all dimensions for this allocation line. Provides comprehensive dimension management interface for detailed financial analysis setup.

procedures.name: CreateDimFromDefaultDim
procedures.doc: Creates dimension set for this allocation line from default dimension setup for the G/L account. Automatically applies standard dimension configuration based on account and posting group defaults.

procedures.name: OnAfterInitDefaultDimensionSources
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after initializing default dimension sources for allocation line dimension creation. Enables custom modification of dimension sources before dimension set creation for allocation lines.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCreateDim
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before creating dimension set for allocation line. Enables custom logic to completely override standard dimension creation processing for allocations.

procedures.name: OnAfterCreateDimProcedure
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after completing dimension creation procedure for allocation line. Enables custom processing and validation after standard dimension set creation is completed.

procedures.name: OnAfterShowDimensions
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after displaying dimensions page for allocation line. Enables custom processing after user interaction with allocation line dimensions.

procedures.name: OnAfterValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after validating shortcut dimension code for allocation line. Enables custom processing after shortcut dimension validation and dimension set updates.

procedures.name: OnBeforeValidateShortcutDimCode
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating shortcut dimension code for allocation line. Enables custom logic to override standard shortcut dimension validation processing.

procedures.name: OnUpdateAllocationsOnAfterGenJnlAllocModify
procedures.doc: Integration event that occurs after modifying a general journal allocation line during update process. Allows customization of allocation line processing after standard modification logic.

procedures.name: OnUpdateAllocationsOnBeforeGenJnlAllocModify
procedures.doc: Integration event that occurs before modifying a general journal allocation line during update process. Allows customization of allocation line values before standard modification logic.

procedures.name: OnUpdateAllocationsAddCurrOnAfterGenJnlAllocModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after modifying allocation line during additional currency allocation updates. Enables custom processing after allocation line changes during ACY amount distribution.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckGLAccount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating G/L account setup for allocation line. Enables custom logic to override standard G/L account validation processing for allocations.

procedures.name: OnAfterCheckGLAccount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after validating G/L account setup for allocation line. Enables custom processing and validation after standard G/L account checks are completed.

procedures.name: OnBeforeUpdateVAT
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before updating VAT amounts for allocation line. Enables custom logic to completely override standard VAT update processing for allocations.

procedures.name: OnAfterUpdateVAT
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after updating VAT amounts for allocation line. Enables custom processing after standard VAT calculation and update is completed.

procedures.name: OnBeforeValidateAccountNo
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating account number for allocation line. Enables custom logic to completely override standard account number validation processing.

procedures.doc: Integration event raised after validating a shortcut dimension code for bank account. Enables custom processing or additional validation after dimension code validation.

procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating IBAN format and check digits. Enables custom IBAN validation logic or handling of special IBAN formats.

procedures.doc: Integration event raised before validating a shortcut dimension code for bank account. Enables custom dimension validation logic or preprocessing before standard validation.

procedures.doc: Integration event for checking if bank account is linked to a statement provider service. Enables bank statement provider integrations to indicate connection status.

procedures.doc: Integration event for checking if automatic logon is possible for the bank account. Enables bank statement provider integrations to indicate authentication capabilities.

procedures.doc: Integration event for unlinking bank account from statement provider service. Enables bank statement provider integrations to handle connection removal.

procedures.doc: Integration event for refreshing bank account connection to statement provider. Enables renewal of authentication or data synchronization with provider services.

procedures.doc: Integration event for retrieving data exchange definition for online bank feeds. Enables dynamic configuration of data format for processing bank statement imports.

procedures.doc: Integration event for updating bank account linking information. Enables maintenance of connection details between bank accounts and statement providers.

procedures.doc: Integration event for retrieving available statement provider services. Enables discovery of available bank statement provider integrations.

procedures.name: CheckGLAcc
procedures.doc: Validates that the specified G/L account exists and is properly configured for VAT posting.

procedures.name: TestNotSalesTax
procedures.doc: Validates that the specified field is not used when VAT Calculation Type is Sales Tax. Prevents configuration of VAT fields that are incompatible with Sales Tax calculation method.

procedures.name: GetSalesAccount
procedures.doc: Returns the appropriate sales VAT G/L account based on whether unrealized VAT is being processed. Retrieves either realized or unrealized sales VAT account with validation for required account setup.

procedures.name: GetPurchAccount
procedures.doc: Returns the appropriate purchase VAT G/L account based on whether unrealized VAT is being processed. Retrieves either realized or unrealized purchase VAT account with validation for required account setup.

procedures.name: GetRevChargeAccount
procedures.doc: Returns the appropriate reverse charge VAT G/L account based on whether unrealized VAT is being processed. Retrieves either realized or unrealized reverse charge VAT account for EU and domestic reverse charge transactions.

procedures.name: SetAccountsVisibility
procedures.doc: Sets visibility flags for unrealized VAT and payment discount adjustment based on General Ledger Setup configuration. Controls UI field visibility for VAT posting setup pages based on system-wide VAT settings.

procedures.name: SuggestSetupAccounts
procedures.doc: Suggests G/L account assignments for VAT posting setup based on existing similar setups and account patterns. Provides automated account suggestion functionality to streamline VAT posting setup configuration.

procedures.name: OnBeforeGetPurchAccount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before retrieving purchase VAT account to allow custom account selection logic. Enables extensions to override standard purchase VAT account determination based on custom business rules.

procedures.name: OnBeforeGetSalesAccount
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before retrieving sales VAT account to allow custom account selection logic. Enables extensions to override standard sales VAT account determination based on custom business rules.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCheckSetupUsage
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before checking VAT posting setup usage to allow custom validation logic. Enables extensions to perform additional validation or override standard setup usage checks.

procedures.name: IncludedInAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Checks whether a dimension value per account record is included in the allowed values filter. Returns true if the dimension value matches the current allowed values filter criteria.

procedures.name: UpdateDimValuesPerAccountFromAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Updates dimension values per account records based on the allowed values filter. Synchronizes the allowed dimension values list with the current filter criteria.

procedures.name: CheckDisallowedDimensionValue
procedures.doc: Validates that a dimension value is not disallowed for use with this default dimension. Prevents assignment of dimension values that are restricted by the allowed values filter.

procedures.name: UpdateDefaultDimensionAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Updates the allowed values filter field based on currently allowed dimension values. Rebuilds the filter string from dimension value per account records marked as allowed.

procedures.name: GetAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Returns the allowed values filter as a text string truncated to field length. Provides the current filter that restricts dimension value selection for this default dimension.

procedures.name: GetFullAllowedValuesFilter
procedures.doc: Returns the complete allowed values filter without length restrictions. Generates a filter string from all allowed dimension values for this default dimension.

procedures.name: UpdateParentType
procedures.doc: Updates the parent type field based on the current table ID. Maps specific table IDs to their corresponding parent type enum values.

procedures.name: UpdateParentId
procedures.doc: Updates the parent ID field based on the current table ID and record number. Links the default dimension to the correct master data record using system IDs.

procedures.name: UpdateReferencedIds
procedures.doc: Updates all referenced ID fields and modifies the record if any changes occurred. Ensures system IDs are synchronized with the current dimension and parent record references.

procedures.name: UpdateReferencedIdFields
procedures.doc: Updates all referenced ID fields and returns whether any changes were made. Coordinates updates to parent ID, parent type, dimension ID, and dimension value ID fields.

procedures.name: CopyFromCustLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Copies data from a customer ledger entry into the buffer table. Transfers all matching fields and calculates remaining amounts.

procedures.name: CopyFromVendLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Copies data from a vendor ledger entry into the buffer table. Maps vendor-specific fields to the corresponding customer/vendor buffer fields.

procedures.name: CopyFromEmplLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Copies data from an employee ledger entry into the buffer table. Maps employee-specific fields to the corresponding customer/vendor buffer fields.

procedures.name: RecalculateAmounts
procedures.doc: Recalculates amounts when converting between different currencies. Updates all currency-related fields using exchange rates from the specified posting date.

procedures.name: SetClosedFields
procedures.doc: Sets the closed fields for a ledger entry buffer with closing information.

procedures.name: GetPmtDiscountDate
procedures.doc: Gets the payment discount date relative to a reference date.

procedures.name: GetRemainingPmtDiscPossible
procedures.doc: Gets the remaining payment discount possible for the entry based on a reference date.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyFromCustLedgerEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying data from a customer ledger entry. Enables customization of the copy process for customer-specific requirements.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyFromVendLedgerEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying data from a vendor ledger entry. Enables customization of the copy process for vendor-specific requirements.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyFromEmplLedgerEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying data from an employee ledger entry. Enables customization of the copy process for employee-specific requirements.

procedures.name: OnAfterSetClosedFields
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after setting closed-related fields in the buffer. Enables custom processing when ledger entries are marked as closed.

procedures.name: OnAfterGetPmtDiscountDate
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after calculating payment discount date. Enables customization of payment discount date calculation logic.

procedures.name: OnAfterGetRemainingPmtDiscPossible
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after getting remaining payment discount possible. Enables customization of payment discount calculations based on specific business rules.

procedures.name: OnAfterRecalculateAmounts
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after recalculating amounts in currency conversion. Enables custom processing when amounts are converted between currencies.

procedures.name: InsertDtldCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Inserts or updates a detailed CV ledger entry buffer record with consolidation logic. Combines entries with matching key fields to avoid duplicate buffer records.

procedures.name: CopyPostingGroupsFromVATEntry
procedures.doc: Copies posting group fields from a VAT entry to the detailed CV ledger entry buffer. Used for VAT-related detailed entries to maintain proper posting setup references.

procedures.name: CopyFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Copies relevant fields from a general journal line to create an initial detailed CV ledger entry. Sets up the buffer with transaction amounts, dimensions, and basic posting information.

procedures.name: InitFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Initializes the detailed CV ledger entry buffer with basic posting information from a general journal line. Sets up document and user identification fields without amounts or detailed data.

procedures.name: CopyFromCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Copies key reference fields from a CV ledger entry buffer to establish parent-child relationship. Links the detailed entry to its parent ledger entry with currency and dimension information.

procedures.name: InitDetailedCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Initializes and inserts a complete detailed CV ledger entry buffer with specified amounts and application data. Creates fully populated detailed entry for payment applications, discounts, and tolerance scenarios.

procedures.name: FindVATEntry
procedures.doc: Finds the corresponding VAT entry for the detailed CV ledger entry using transaction number and posting groups. Used to link detailed entries with their related VAT transactions for reporting and analysis.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying fields from a general journal line to the detailed CV ledger entry buffer. Enables customization of field mapping and additional data population from journal lines.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyFromCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying reference fields from a CV ledger entry buffer. Enables customization of field mapping and additional data population from parent ledger entries.

procedures.name: OnAfterCopyPostingGroupsFromVATEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after copying posting groups from a VAT entry. Enables customization of VAT-related posting group assignments and validation.

procedures.name: OnAfterInitFromGenJnlLine
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after initializing basic fields from a general journal line. Enables customization of initialization logic and additional field setup.

procedures.name: OnAfterInsertDtldCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised after inserting a detailed CV ledger entry buffer record. Enables post-processing of inserted detailed entries and related buffer updates.

procedures.name: OnBeforeInsertDtldCVLedgEntry
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before inserting a detailed CV ledger entry buffer in the initialization process. Enables custom validation and processing before detailed entry creation.

procedures.name: OnBeforeCreateDtldCVLedgEntryBuf
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before creating a detailed CV ledger entry buffer during consolidation. Enables custom logic for entry consolidation and duplicate detection.

procedures.name: OnInsertDtldCVLedgEntryOnBeforeInsert
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before inserting a new detailed CV ledger entry buffer record. Enables final validation and field modifications before database insertion.

procedures.name: OnInsertDtldCVLedgEntryOnBeforeModify
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before modifying an existing detailed CV ledger entry buffer during consolidation. Enables custom logic for amount aggregation and field updates in consolidated entries.

procedures.name: OnInsertDtldCVLedgEntryOnBeforeNewDtldCVLedgEntryBufInit
procedures.doc: Integration event raised before initializing a new detailed CV ledger entry buffer during the insertion process. Enables custom setup and field population before detailed entry processing begins.
